prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE full-body pixel-art action keypose of the SAME stout adult canal brigand in reference 1 (ready pose), reference 2 (identity mother). Genuine transparent RGBA background, no board, no text, no environment, no ground or shadow. Keep coarse visible square pixel clusters and restrained brown/gray palette, hard pixel edges, stocky proportions, thick beard, left-facing mild three-quarter camera. Keep screen-right layered leather shoulder pad and rope-tied pouch, screen-left red hem patch, both complete brown wrapped boots visible with generous transparent margins.

POSE TARGET: the EARLY-MIDDLE phase of a short downward club swing, just below chest height, before reaching the waist. The club is swung OUT in front of the chest toward screen-left. The weapon fist stays at LOWER STERNUM height, clearly ABOVE the rope belt by at least a fist's width. Open the original screen-left weapon elbow forward substantially from the ready pose, but keep elbow flexed. The short club projects to screen-left from this fist, only 10–15 degrees downward from horizontal. CRITICAL: the ENTIRE rounded club head and its one iron band must remain ABOVE THE TOP OF THE ROPE BELT, aligned against the lower chest, not the hip or knee. The fist is slightly higher than the head. Club head left of the body in empty air; no overlap with face or knee. This is a downward arc keypose with slight forward torso follow-through, not a straight locked-arm stab. Think a clock hand transitioning from 11 o'clock toward 9 o'clock, stopped just below 9 o'clock; NOT at 7 o'clock.

Preserve precisely ONE SHORT thick tapered wooden club with rounded blunt end and ONE gray iron band near that end, same head-to-hand proportions as reference 1; no hammer, spikes, blade, long handle, duplicate band. Original weapon hand grips firmly with connected wrist, fingers wrapped around handle; other hand remains screen-right at lower ribs, off weapon. Front knee takes weight slightly, rear leg remains planted, stance not an extreme lunge or squat; both soles supported at the implied ground. Body stays as tall/stocky as reference rather than squat chibi. Single complete person, all limbs and both boot soles entirely in canvas. No extra hands, motion lines, ghost limbs, blood, victim or impact. This is only one candidate concept, not a spritesheet or verified animation.
